白嫖转支持,确实有新意,而不是单纯的换皮,(要说换皮,哈哈哈,还是得三国战记不是 )有想法的作者永远值得支持(被某志某记搞怕了) 都三个人血月5了,提一些看法吧,不知道有没有用: 1.速度还是慢了,尤其是敌人行动,我都是要开变速5倍数才勉强能接受(变速还变不了敌人行动间隔) 2.最终boss曹丕??太掉逼格了,说实话整个三国他算老几??左慈,南华,甚至老朋友蚩尤都比他好; 3.角色还是少,一会就体验完了,三个人,至少得向三国战记7个人啊,是7个吧?? 4.局外养成太少,没有重复的动力,不说局外刷数值,可以向jianta的解锁新卡牌或者宝物啊,或者向因地势谎言,解锁新的开局天赋,开局卡牌等等^; 5.卡牌还可以精致一点, 6.3个肥肥小怪塞污染牌变成了伪随机,会一直顶在牌堆顶部,导致天崩^记得以前不是这样;说实话这三个怪绝对是游戏第一粪,高攻击,高护甲,无法上流血,多人数,污染卡池,高攻击欲望,完克大部分套路......做什么小怪啊,连精英都不是你敢信,做关底大boss算了.(姜维死门改了我一脸懵) 7,还有一些卡牌和宝物,非常之鸡肋^没有设计好,怪物对污染,弃牌,等等机制也比较少,单调的叠攻防. 8, 6.......先这么多啊,想起来再补充.

尖塔的内核早已被验证过千百遍，所以本作基于“爬塔”玩法的游戏性与趣味性自然不必质疑。 目前登场的三个人物也设计出了适配其历史的三条发展道路，加之三国题材天生的好感+1。 花了半小时内浅浅尝试了两个人物，虽然都没能打过第二个BOSS，但依然有跃跃欲试继续挑战的感觉，这很难得！当然也不排除是“赶新鲜”而导致的…… 战斗的特色在于敌方进攻的时候也可以出牌反击，进攻反杀亦可，防守叠甲亦可，于是在原有卡牌玩法的灵活性上发展出了更多的可能。 从皮囊看虽说有些“千篇一律”，但灵魂层面不说是万里挑一，至少是可圈可点了。
好玩
游戏一开始是冲着三国题材去的（三国杀不是），简单玩了一下，说是肉鸽游戏但也不算难，卡牌的构筑很不错，这简直就是为我这种打牌爬塔菜鸡量身定做的爽游，遗物给得特别大方，最亮眼的是那个辅助牌，十分新颖亮眼。目前玩着还不错，期待后续更新吧。
挺好玩的，就是我太菜了，玩到现在只用关兴过了一次普通难度，血月一都打不过被斩于马下了，玩张星彩也打不过第三层，也是给自己菜笑了，属于是没摸清楚流派，乱抓牌导致的。
没玩其他角色 但是关兴的满月难度 过于离谱 初始的卡打将帅 即打不死也防不住 游戏变成不停的重开直到拿到关键的遗物或者卡

Overall, I like this game, but if you're asking whether i'd recommend it to my friend, my answer would be NO. I haven't experience everything the game has to offer yet, but as a fan of card-building rougelikes, I feel like there are a lot of flaws here. I'll keep playing and if things improve, I'll keep playing and if things improve, I'll change my review to a positive one. 1.Difficulty is too easy Take the character Xing Cai Zhang ( I am very good at ) as an example. Once I get the skill that"spends all arrows, each dealing 3 damage," I'm pretty sure I can clear the run. After playing for so long, I've only lost twice (and that was because I didn't draw that card), which shows the game is really imbalanced. More on that below. 2.Balance between mechanics, cards and items is off It's obvious the devs tried to create a lot of different systems, but in practice. most of them feel half-baked. Some systems barely show up, and a lot of the cards are useless. Same with the items. The gameplay gets old really fast because of this. 3.Too little randomness It's basically the same Boss every time, even at high difficulty. I haven't even encountered some of the BOSS I expected to see, based on theory. Events are few and far between, and most of the are positive events. While this makes the game easier, it really hurts the replayability and overall fun factor. As a Slay the Spire player, it's clear this game is inspired by it, but it does try to innovate on the core mechanics, so it's not just a clone. It's got some fresh ideas, which is cool. Also as a Three Kingdoms fan, I love the strong Three Kingdoms theme and the retro art style. Those are definitely plus points for me. In conclusion, if you're looking for a fresh take on card-based rougelikes, this game is worth trying ou. The gameplay will definitely catch your attention. But overall, it's unbalanced and too easy, which holds it back from being a great game. I hope that this game will become more polished and enjoyable in the future.
有种在玩三国杀的感觉，桃加生命233333太经典了 开局4个角色可选，应该是不同风格流派，诸葛亮流派对新手来说有点不是很好上手，真就谈笑间樯橹灰飞烟灭了........ 新手比较推荐先玩左一的角色先。 牌不会回收，算是深度和广度都做的比较好的卡牌，而且自带三国特色，要是画点美女图应该早就爆了。

[h3]初见这游戏界面，绝对会让你想起一个同类型4个字的游戏，我不说，你也绝对猜得到！[/h3] 卡牌游戏有很多，三国风格的也有不少，唯独该作里各种角色都让我有一种熟悉或者说怀旧的感觉——不晓得是不是以前老游戏玩多了？什么《三国志》、《三国战纪》、《吞食天地》这种，我都有涉猎。 游戏当前有4个可玩角色（我知道又有人要说那款游戏了），同样给予了我们4套卡牌，且每种角色又各有不同的流派构筑，如果想要全都体验，保守估计该作游玩时间不会低于30小时。对于卡牌大佬来说，全角色血满月的时间应该不低于50小时！ [u]该作比较有特色或者说区别于其他卡牌游戏的地方，我觉得是在敌方回合，我方也可以使用手牌进行防守或反击——这进一步使得攻击类卡牌的实用性要远远高于防守类卡牌。[/u] [b]当熟悉卡牌效果以及掌握套路之后，基本都是复读机。 当前已全成就达成，介于篇幅问题，下面简单分享一下各角色流派。具体流派套路已分享于xhh，欢迎移步至xhh社区参阅。 关兴流派 1.气力流 2.斩杀流 3.燃血爆发流 4.杀意反击流 5.左右横跳流（跳跃） 星彩流派（分为攻击端及防御端） 攻击端 1.敏捷射击流 2.出血流 3.近战削弱流 防御端 1.无限闪避（蹲伏） 2.无限回合流（天干地支） 姜维流派 1.羽扇反击流 2.羽扇燃烧流 3.宁静待发流 4.桃木剑聚气流 5.复制秒杀流 刘谌流派 1.巨大流 2.撒币流 3.生命流 4.催眠流 5.延时流 6.左右横跳流之低配版（灵犀蘑菇）[/b] [i]——部分流派可能我没提及的，也欢迎各位大佬们进行补充！[/i] 再次感谢看到这里的朋友，祝各位早日通关最高难度血满月！ [code] 点击关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/26214428] 電玩狂熱愛好者 [/url] ，以获取更多游戏评测、资讯、攻略 [/code]

逆天难度，比怪物火车还逆天。 打司马懿那关，司马懿150血每次攻击12血，我就10血，酒能回满血逆天的是休息和酒场都不能补充酒。 司马懿那关的精英怪比司马懿一个boss还逆天，一个精英关三个怪，一个怪20血一次攻击8血，三个怪下来我直接掉了两瓶酒根本打不过司马懿，还有那个酒瓶怪30血打残了一个技能满血。 两只熊大一个15血7攻，这游戏最逆天的就是不会显示怪有什么技能，小怪boss技能是什么都不知道完全不知道怎么防。 存了一堆卡准备一套秒熊大，结果他莫名其妙吼一下给我卡全丢了，那酒瓶也是要死了一个感叹号【进行非攻击行动】就完了，然后直接满血。 那三个大炮也是没提示，一个回合加8力气，然后一平A打我15血直接给我秒了，我打司马懿boss都没有被秒，结果我打个精英小怪给我秒了。 而且这几儿玩意，风灵月影都没有修改器，是差劲到修改器都没有
低难度还行，高难度平衡性很差，卡牌数量比较少，玩多了没什么意思，而且不删牌根本玩不了，初始卡组强度极低，随便一个小怪都打不过，所以打到最后都是初始卡删光的小卡组打无限，或者是靠恰好得到的遗物都很好所带来的高数值，然而一个卡牌游戏要靠遗物的强度才能打也太奇怪了吧。

————————大部分都通了之后追评——————————————— 这个游戏是类塔中比较优秀的作品，每个职业的几个流派都挺有意思，各个流派之间也有配合，难度不大的同时也有不低的爽点，每个职业10个难度，全通也很快 可以看出创作者是知道自己的长版和短板的，并没有一味无脑的去抄袭塔 大约能玩20小时，全成就的话大概40小时左右 —————————————————————————————————— 玩了四个小时，体验不错，推荐给想玩一个类塔游戏，而又不是塔的mod的玩家，20元玩上几天也不亏。 在类塔的基础上有所创新，对方攻击的时候自己能打牌应对，互相行动一回合有意思不少，算是强化了敌我交互。 缺点不少，例如前三个角色的玩法依然是《塔》的战猎机的机制。战猎还能说是通用机制，很难不同，但是机器人的浮游炮就有点过了。 单个角色的深度不足，而且有点失衡，前两个角色还合格，但是机器人第二次玩我就用几张扇子卡在强化扇子的遗物下无脑赢了，顺便解锁了 5卡通关成就 鸡煲在这里很强。 鸡煲在这里很强。

今天刚看到还有杀戮尖塔这个游戏，虽然还没玩过，但是在网上搜了搜发现不就跟这个游戏一模一样吗 虽然没玩过所谓什么杀戮尖塔，但大数据推给我了必须说两句。 刷到杀戮尖塔，我点进去一看这卡牌构筑+Roguelike玩法怎么这么眼熟？？？ 好家伙！技能描述、UI布局、连BOSS战机制都如出一辙啊！现在支持原创都这么难了吗？ 作为蜀末深度体验过的老玩家，今天必须把话撂在这——《杀戮尖塔》就是踩着《蜀末血月三国》的肩膀上位的抄袭惯犯！别跟我扯什么“卡牌Roguelike玩法通用”的鬼话，核心机制、数值体系甚至美术细节都高度重合，当玩家是瞎的吗？ 看看《杀戮尖塔》运营怎么做的：玩家在Steam评论区质疑抄袭，秒删评+拉黑；主播对比视频刚上传就被“版权投诉”；甚至买水军在各大论坛刷“玩法相似很正常”的洗地言论。反观《蜀末》团队，人家大大方方说“受经典卡牌游戏启发”，还在设定集里标注了对传统三国文化的考据——同样是做游戏，怎么有人就敢把“借鉴”包装成“原创”？ 最后送《杀戮尖塔》团队一句话：卡牌肉鸽赛道不是法外之地，靠抄袭换皮赚快钱的时代早过去了！真当中国玩家看不出谁在用心做游戏，谁在割韭菜？建议立刻公开道歉+赔偿《蜀末》研发团队，否则我们玩家集体差评轰炸到底！ #游戏圈迷惑行为 #蚌埠住了 #缝合怪竟是我自己#游戏抄袭实锤#国产游戏支棱起来 #杀戮尖塔请道歉

It was okay, and for that reason alone not recommended. There are a lot of better deckbuilders out there. This one had a interesting idea where you only play one card then its the enemies turn, but in the end the game isnt that fun beyond a run or two. I had fun, but felt zero need to ever go back, it doesnt have staying power.

As the other negrevs state, nevermind the fact that there are AI assets (which i can't trust to be used ethically at this point in time) and the UI leaves a lot to be desired, the gameplay itself is okay, even good sometimes, it tries to do something slightly different... but not enough to not be "worse slay the spire". The balance is rather dubious at times, seemingly allowing for fairly easy run winning combos. At least the synergistic interactibility of cards and relic is somewhat decent, and the enemy design isn't the worst, but they tend to always veer between completely harmless and threatening to take you out from 100 to 0 in a turn over a few poorly aligned stars. The healing mechanic is a mixed bag of way too generous until it's not aswell. It's just somewhere between above average and below average at best, not worth playing more than a couple runs, unless you're really desperate for a new deckbuilder, it could scratch the itch a bit.

特有规则或键位备忘：退出游戏自动存档，继续即回到接近当前。开局第一次事件的第一次选牌，可无限刷新；干掉头目过地图后回血也回酒。出牌费用不是按点数，是按次数算，牌有五种类型攻防技辅扰；我方出牌时，若无道具等可出“攻”一次，“技”可无限出，“辅”不可出类似装备有被动效果，“防”一般不可出，“扰”若有道具可无限出以避免负面效果；敌方单人攻击我方时，若无道具等可出防或攻或技一次（即可无限出的牌不能无限出，若敌方有三人，会分别共出三次牌依次结算）；结算完就过一回合，再到我方行动。护盾若无道具等只能保留一回合；闪避可无限回合保留；降防好像可无限回合有效。每回合一般抽4张牌，回合结束时低于5张手牌不会丢弃；下回合再抽4张，回合结束时若不用只能最大持有5张，其它得选择性丢弃（这是特有机制，有些负面效果牌若无其它手段丢弃就得靠这个了）；若手牌大于20张时好像（手牌最大20张），多的牌是回到弃牌堆好像。术语“连营”的意思是，在敌方攻击我方的时候，出了含连营的防后可以继续再出一次牌。“出血”状态的描述4点出血造成一格血伤害会误认为只有4点或8点时才生效，实际1点出血状态也生效造成一格血的四分之一伤害；其它类似需要4点的状态的描述好像都这样。“遭埋伏”意思是遇敌时敌人先攻，而不是只在“迷”图标事件中可能会遇到敌人；先攻和先手意思不一样，先攻是进入被敌人攻击的状态若此时出牌不会先受到攻击，先手是进入被敌人攻击的状态若此时出牌会先受到攻击。道具的升级，如断弓，获得2点敏捷，升级后描述应当显示为4点，实际还是显示2点，请纠正；好像类似的点数升级都有这个情况。抽“箭矢”牌意思是，抽说明里含有箭矢字样的牌，不是牌的名字；其它类似。使用箭矢的射击，若攻击闪避的敌人，箭矢不能插在敌人身上以及回收；眩晕可以破闪避，但是不能消耗闪避次数。遇事件时，若需要道具，道具不会消耗；当前说明会误认为给出并消耗。赌场概率是固定的，前两次铁定赢，后面绝大多数是输；建议随机概率才像赌场。第三个英雄的某张卡牌，有隐藏效果，没有提示，估计是故意为之以达解谜效果；如果不是故意，请添加说明。 One of the best card battlers I've played. Clearly inspired by Slay the Spire; does a few things worse, but most of it is better than the inspiration, and that's very high praise. The card collection could be bigger, but also, it is sufficient for distinct builds for each character, all of them perfectly viable (a difficult balance to reach). And that's another thing. The characters feel so different to one another in a way very few games manage. Getting a "badass" skin for each after you beat half the game with them is a nice objective to chase at the beginning. The game is RNG heavy at first, but then, it depends on you to make coherent choices to make the best out of what is presented to you. If you lose past boss 2, that's on you. It feels fair. Enemy variety is there; the random enchantments they can get definitely spice up encounters, and getting warned on the boss of the chapter so you can adjust your deck accordingly is a good inheritance from Slay the Spire. Two things I don't like, that's it: some relics are way too powerful and warp the game around them. The bow that gives +4 Agility each time an arrow is spend is so much further behind anything else that they don't seem from the same game. And also, I'd appreciate a way to skip the animation every time you're given the choice to buff your enemies for money at the start of each chapter. Glowing review otherwise. Cheap, meaty game.

Really cool game. The tweaks it makes to the combat rules standard in the genre are very clever, and it has linear, per-character iterative difficulty (a la StS ascensions) as opposed to the customizable modifiers that have become common in many similar games (but which I personally hate). The four characters are also very unique, and each have at least a couple different mechanics they can build around. I also got it for less than $3, which is crazy. The translation is surprisingly solid, though there's still a few awkward spots, and the tooltips explaining the mechanics are thorough and mostly easy to understand. Just don't expect much tie-in to the Three Kingdoms theme beyond the names of characters and places, as there's not any story to speak of. The only "buyer beware" I would throw in is that this is *not* a challenging game, at least up through Blood Moon (Ascension) IV that I've played so far. It's more of a "how can I have fun with creatively broken builds" kind of game compared to a lot of others in the genre. Update: the game does start to get a (liiittle) bit of challenge around Blood Moon (Ascension) VIII, YMMV.
